fieldDescriptions.Language: The UI language updates immediately after saving.
fieldDescriptions.Theme: Appearance of the search bar and the settings window.
fieldDescriptions.SearchBarOffset: Offset from the center of the primary screen’s work area, in DIP; 0 means centered, and positive values move right/down.
fieldDescriptions.SearchEngine: Search engine used by Web Search mode.
fieldDescriptions.ClearQueryOnHide: Clear the typed query whenever the search bar hides.
fieldDescriptions.LaunchAtStartup: Starts in the background and stays in the system tray after you sign in to Windows; the search bar does not open automatically.
fieldDescriptions.SkipWhenFullscreenAppActive: When the foreground app covers its entire monitor, the global shortcut will not open the search bar; clicking the tray icon always opens it.
fieldDescriptions.AskAiUrlTemplate: Must contain {0}; the query replaces this placeholder.
fieldDescriptions.ModePreferences: Choose which modes appear in mode switching. Drag a row or use the up/down buttons to change the order; at least one mode must stay enabled.
fieldDescriptions.DictionaryFilePath: Accepts .txt (CC-CEDICT text, or generic lines of "headword + tab + definition"), .csv, .gz/.zip archives, or a StarDict dictionary (*.ifo, Chinese to English). A StarDict .ifo needs its .idx and .dict/.dict.dz beside it with the same base name. Leave empty to use the user data directory or the bundled file.
fieldDescriptions.EcdictFilePath: Accepts .txt (generic lines of "headword + tab + definition"), .csv (such as ecdict.csv), .gz/.zip archives, or a StarDict dictionary (*.ifo, English to Chinese). A StarDict .ifo needs its .idx and .dict/.dict.dz beside it with the same base name. Leave empty to use the user data directory or the bundled file.
fieldDescriptions.ToggleVisibilityShortcut: Global shortcut: shows the hidden search bar and hides it while visible. Default Alt+Space; press Esc while recording to clear it.
fieldDescriptions.CycleModeShortcut: Tap to cycle modes; press and hold to open the mode wheel, then release to confirm. Must be a single key without modifiers.
fieldDescriptions.HideOnEscape: When enabled, pressing Esc while the search bar is visible hides it to the tray.
fieldDescriptions.ExecuteShortcut: Opens browser results in web modes and shows dictionary definitions in Dictionary mode.
fieldDescriptions.SelectPreviousShortcut: Moves selection up in dictionary candidates or the mode wheel.
fieldDescriptions.SelectNextShortcut: Moves selection down in dictionary candidates or the mode wheel.
